title: Review translations and preserve approved wording
summary: Review translated wording while preserving English and staff-reviewed versions.

evidence: server/src/utils/guideOracleKnowledge.js: reviewed original fact objects at b8345be4d2f7a097e81cb03eef64b473abd0cec9

sections.title: Review and save translated wording for a managed resource
paragraphs: You must be able to edit the exact resource. English is the main version. Save the English public content first so the translation review compares against the current saved source.
steps: Open Dashboard → Manage My Resources and select Edit on the exact Place or Offering. For a template, use Edit Template on that saved template.
Open Translate. If the editor says to save the resource first, complete the English save, reopen the saved resource and return to Translate.
Choose the language card you want to review. Read its status and the fields needing attention alongside the displayed English wording.
If translated text is missing, use Fill all missing text or Refresh this language as appropriate, then review the generated wording rather than accepting it unseen.
Use Show all translated fields when you need to check or adjust fields that are currently hidden because they are ready.
Correct the visible translated text against the English meaning. Check names, instructions and sensitive wording carefully.
Select Save review and wait for the saved-review notice. Repeat for other languages that need review.
Reopen the review or the permitted public-language view to check the saved wording. If an action fails, review the error and current source before retrying.
notes: Saving unchanged automatically prepared text marks it reviewed. Changing the wording marks it staff edited, and staff-edited wording is not overwritten automatically when English changes.
Save review is a separate saved operation from Save Place, Save Offering or Save Template. Switching languages or closing an unsaved review does not submit edited text.
Refresh/fill actions respect protected staff-edited wording; do not promise a force-overwrite control. Review any retained wording after the English source changes.
Use the correct template or place-version editor for inherited versus local fields. Do not infer that translating a shared template and translating a local override are the same operation.
The Guide cannot translate or save edits to an existing resource in chat. Keep private operating information out of public-language fields.

facts.title: Translate a managed Programme/service
facts.message: The Guide cannot translate or edit an existing Programme/service in chat. If Edit is available on the exact listing, open Manage My Resources → Offerings → Edit → Translate. Save its English content first, then review the language cards. The editor can fill missing translated text or refresh one language; check the wording and choose Save review. English remains the main version, and staff-edited wording is not overwritten automatically. The server checks permission for the selected listing.
